correctness.rationale: The mgf (1-p)/[(1-a1 z)(1-a2 z)(1-a3 z)-p] follows from geometric complete circuits. For t=(1-p)^-1 and normalized elementary symmetrics x=e2/e1^2, y=e3/e1^3, R=(4/3)(t-x)[t^3-3t^2x+t(x^2+2y)]/[t^2-2tx+y]^2. The inequality R>=6/5 reduces to P0+q P1+q^2 P2+q^3 P3+q^4>=0, q=p/(1-p), with all Pi positive except P0>=0 proved from Schur y>=(4x-1)/9 and positivity at x<=1/4. Equality only at q=0, x=1/3. Independent SymPy verified the polynomial, exact local second-variation coefficient 4(1-p)^3(50-10p-13p^2)/(p^2+16p+10)^3>0, quartic benchmark crossing p* between .5425 and .5426, and exact strictly positive witness R(1,1,1;5/8)-R(1,1,1/16;5/8)=8340/345550921. Boundary a3=0 is used only as a limiting comparison, with actual a3=1/16 positive.
